name: Graph Contracts — semantic period-contracts (never-widen at the value layer)
description: DS~A SEED (Andrew-direct 2026-06-15, follow-on to closed NFRA_PIPESCRIPT; brief docs/briefs/period-contracts-seed-benchmark-20260615.md = 48635a865). Origin = the BMKAUD semantic-break class (Model Portfolios /performance 1M column, 2026-06-01): a SmartX override replaced the canonical Yang-PKL benchmark numbers AND SmartX's 1M=last-complete-calendar-month differed from Yang's trailing-1M -- STRUCTURE was fine (fresh, present, valid float) so no alarm fired; Andrew caught it by eye, then a multi-day hand audit reconstructed who-writes-what. A period_contract is the machine-readable invariant that would have caught it: BOTH the reference frame the Nessie/Iceberg version-history is diffed against AND the allow-list the diff is judged by -- versioning a graph without semantic anchors only says 'stuff moved'; the contract turns the snapshot diff into 'what flipped, and of those which crossed a line nobody re-drew'. It is the machine encoding of CLAUDE.md never-widen pushed to the VALUE layer (a benchmark source/period flip IS served-output-SEMANTICS movement; the ratified contract edit IS the recorded sign-off). graph_contracts table co-located on globgrph Nessie main beside graph_nodes/graph_edges (every contract edit = an attributable Nessie commit; net-new, no collision). THREE limbs, one declaration: structure (graph diff Q1) + policy (contract JOIN Q2 -> UNSANCTIONED/exit 2 when a forbidden_writer appears with no ratified contract edit) + value (period_defs check, codified WS-2, run against the served column). Surfaces in pipescript: --contract <thread> (declared canonical_writer/period_defs/ratified_by + observed drift) + --flipped --since <snapshot> (each window flip tagged SANCTIONED / UNSANCTIONED(exit 2) / uncontracted=LOUD-unreviewed -- the same false-clean discipline now on the value layer).
